references.text: The Lord gives the command to do to Ai as they did to Jericho, and allows them to take the spoil
Jericho was completely destroyed, a foreshadowing of Ai's destruction
The fulfillment of the command to set fire to the city
The Lord's command to Joshua to hold fast to everything that has been commanded
God's command to burn the Canaanite cities with fire
Israel burned the Midianites' cities with fire as a pattern for warfare
Judah set fire to Jerusalem after capturing the city
The Israelites set fire to the cities of the tribe of Benjamin
